name: Tavern Farkle GB
storyline:
Tavern Farkle GB brings the old dice game to the Game Boy. Roll six dice, set aside what scores, and decide: bank thy points and walk away safe, or push thy luck for one more roll. A single match takes minutes, which makes it dangerously easy to just play one more.

Two ways to play. In Quick Match, pick a goal and face a random villager, a Peasant, Baker, Miller, Smith, or Knight, each with a playstyle that changes from match to match. In the Devil's Dice Tournament, thou'lt face six opponents in a row, Baldric the wily bard, Gertrude the grim-gambler, Martin McPie, Henry the sword seeker, Brunhild the dice valkyrie, and finally Lucifer himself, each carrying their own Devil's Die to swing a roll their way. Lose once, and the tournament starts anew.
summary: Tavern Farkle GB is a push-your-luck dice game for the Game Boy. Roll six dice, bank your points or risk it all. Play a quick match against a random villager, or take on six opponents in a row, ending with Lucifer himself and his wild Devil's Die.
